purpose: Teach: 養育/全滅/大佐/私学/プロパガンダ/痴漢/偽善/処方箋

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、養育不全による発達障害の研究を医療チームで参照しております
lines.en: Ren, we're consulting on developmental disorders related to nutritional neglect as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, clinical tone without coldness. Even breath. Direct eye contact level. The precision of someone who has explained this before, many times, to many people.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染で病棟が全滅状態になる事態を医療チームで防ぎます
lines.en: Yes — and our medical team is working to prevent the ward from reaching a critical infection situation.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring without being falsely warm. Slight emphasis on 'prevent' — the weight of responsibility sits lightly in her voice, not defensively.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 退役大佐の医療相談を、貴院、ご担当されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital handled the medical consultation for the retired colonel, then, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, respectful. Leans slightly forward — not pushing, just interested. The tone of someone asking to understand, not to test.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、私学病院との連携を医療チームで強化しております
lines.en: Yes — we're strengthening our coordination with private hospitals through our medical team.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no apology in it. Breath steady. The slight pause before 'strengthening' suggests this is ongoing work, not finished.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療プロパガンダに惑わされぬよう、貴院、患者にご指導されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital guides patients so they aren't misled by medical propaganda, then, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing gently. The cadence of someone thinking aloud, not accusing. Quiet respect underneath the question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、痴漢被害者の心のケアを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — we handle the emotional care for victims of harassment as part of our medical team's work.
lines.style: No lightness. Grounded, serious tone. The words land with care. A pause before 'emotional care' — acknowledging the weight of what that means.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療慈善と偽善の線引きを、貴院、なさっておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital draws a clear line between medical charity and mere appearance of it, then, Doctor?
lines.style: Slower pace. Thoughtful, searching for understanding. The tone of someone wrestling with something important, inviting the doctor to meet him there.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、処方箋の電子化を医療チームで導入いたしました
lines.en: Yes — we've implemented electronic prescriptions across our medical team.
lines.style: Factual closure. Breath slightly settled, like reaching the end of a list. Quieter on the final word, as if it's the small, solid thing that matters after the bigger questions.
